status: Read-only prioritization and proposed acceptance checklist; findings/advice, not promotion

unchanged_authoritative_metric.rule: Full=all material responsibilities of the family have verified shared Go support with declarative inputs and preserved guards. Partial=some shared Go support exists but a material responsibility is missing/held. Unsupported=no verified Go workflow. Partial/unsupported earn zero completion credit; no invented0.5 scores or counts of duplicate historical scripts. Python references/tests may verify Go; operational Python remains an unmet Go responsibility.

proposed_separate_metric.rule: Six equally weighted material acceptance groups per original core family. Credit1 only for proven shared support with cited accepted evidence; partial/missing/held earn0. These groupings are proposed planning data, not a change to frozen family boundaries. All six required groups must be proved before recommending a family Full.
proposed_separate_metric.warning: Checklist completion is not code reuse, percent migrated scripts, equal effort, remaining duration, or a replacement for5/14. Counts depend on this explicit versioned grouping. Native unknowns are not dismissed to increase scores.

shortest_defensible_sixth.recommendation: First complete declarative curated specs plus measured/source-bound batch manifests and shared checkerboard/before-after/contact-sheet presentation. This closes original positive duties without depending on native text scale, CFG/register liveness or allocator safety.

Reuse resizeRaster only for its actual scaling contract and existing font/run data where suitable. Freeze thumbnail dimension rounding and font source; test complete output pixels and index links.

shortest_defensible_sixth.owner_boundary: Prefer authorTexture for IO/recipe orchestration and existing texture/index owners for decode/metadata. Do not force canvas layout into texture, numerical resizeRaster or text-oriented composeCells through mode flags. If the actual implementation cannot keep a small canvas loop readable within an existing appropriate owner, ONE pure preview-composition owner is justified by that independent responsibility; no new per-format/per-batch helper framework.
remaining_uncertainties: Confirm which advisory detector/tier/scoring outputs are material discovery measurement under the original source crosswalk; do not silently count an annotation-only manifest as that duty.
Freeze label-font/caption support and thumbnail dimension rules before code; native game scale/TTF renderer completion is not required merely to label preview IDs.
Ensure declarations cover archive/member provenance where selected assets originate from CMB; a raw TXD listing alone is not the full batch index.

comparative_priorities.reason: Bounded image/table operations atop completed codec and safe publisher; no unresolved native execution semantics.

Four of six acceptance groups already proved, but canonical expected-vs-installed content and complete selected reader/pool evidence remain. One more status template or generic report wrapper would not close them. Could become shorter only if a positive original-duty crosswalk proves remaining audits require no currently held grammar/reader semantics.

Existing raw/snapshot owner is strong, but required-field import, speaker/page/marker/glyph policy and glossary/correction ownership are real remaining duties. Generic draft insertion does not replace them.
Current inline-icon work is useful but TTF and donor/reconstruction duties remain; do not choose it for a quick Full claim.
Native scale/geometry, GP/CFG/interior reference reasoning, and cave/ELF-BSS allocation require independent primary proof, not just another adapter.

verification_method: Static JSON/source/test/evidence reading and Serena owner/caller analysis only. No project Python imports, application execution, tests/build, ISO/canonical/runtime access or source modifications. Accepted proof statements are cited, not re-executed. Current inline-icon WIP excluded; raster status comes from accepted evidence and authoritative coverage.
limitations: Checklist milestones are equally weighted acceptance groups, not estimated complexity; zero credit for partial groups can understate useful implementation.
No implementation/coverage/family approval or wallclock ETA. User requested achievable milestones; full suites remain deferred to the integrated checkpoint.

No requirement to reproduce every historical CLI spelling, every source instance or every optional rendering/scanner heuristic. Conversely no material original duty may be dropped solely to raise the percentage.
